identificationModule.briefTitle: Clinical Study on the Safety and Relationship of Sintilimab Combined With Chemotherapy in Neoadjuvant Treatment of Locally Advanced Rectal Adenocarcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: Safety and Efficacy Evaluation of Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy Without Radiotherapy Combined With Sintilimab for Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer: Short-term Results of a Single-arm Phase 2 Trial

leadSponsor.name: The First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is designed as a single-center, phase II exploratory clinical trial to evaluate the pathological response rate and safety of sintilimab (PD-1 inhibitor) combined with XELOX regimen (oxaliplatin + capecitabine) for neoadjuvant treatment of LARC. The study focuses on the pMMR/MSS patient population and attempts to provide a new treatment option for patients who cannot tolerate radiotherapy or need to preserve organ function.

armGroups.label: the feasibility of neoadjuvant treatment of locally advanced rectal adenocarcinoma with sintilimab c
armGroups.description: Sintilimab (3 mg/kg, IV, qd for patients with body weight \< 60 kg; 200 mg, IV, qd for patients with body weight ≥ 60 kg) combined with XELOX (oxaliplatin 130 mg/m2, IV, qd + capecitabine 1000 mg/m2, bid, d1 - d14, q21d) for 2-4 courses

interventions.name: Sintilimab combined with XELOX
interventions.description: Sintilimab (3 mg/kg, IV, qd for patients with body weight \< 60 kg; 200 mg, IV, qd for patients with body weight ≥ 60 kg) combined with XELOX (oxaliplatin 130 mg/m2, IV, qd + capecitabine 1000 mg/m2, bid, d1 - d14, q21d) for 2-4 courses

primaryOutcomes.measure: An exploratory, phase II clinical study on the feasibility of neoadjuvant treatment of locally advanced rectal adenocarcinoma with sintilimab combined with chemotherapy
primaryOutcomes.description: Objective response rate refers to the proportion of patients who achieve complete response (CR) and partial response (PR) among the treated patients within a certain period of time.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From enrollment to 2-4 courses (about 4-8 weeks) of adjuvant therapy
